item.title: Indonesians protest over land-clearing fires
item.description: Students and activists protested across Indonesia over forest fires linked to land clearing for palm oil plantations.

item.title: US envoy Barrack defends decision to join Israel in war on Iran
item.description: US envoy Tom Barrack says President Trump did not follow Israel in going to war against Iran.

item.title: More than 250,000 displaced in Yemen since fighting escalated: UNHCR
item.description: UNICEF says escalating fighting in Taiz is threatening its water systems, serving an estimated three million people.

item.title: Israeli attacks kill at least four Palestinians in Gaza
item.description: A couple and a 17-year-old are among those killed by Israeli air attacks and gunfire in the Gaza Strip.

item.title: ‘Every day could cost lives’: UK government blocks Gaza families’ reunion
item.description: Britain’s reopened refugee resettlement scheme offers no escape for Palestinians in Gaza.

item.title: ‘Horizontal revolt’: Why Albania’s young protesters want PM Rama to go
item.description: From the ‘Flamingo Revolution’ to current protests, an inside look at a leaderless youth uprising challenging Edi Rama.

item.title: Why Rubio is visiting Reliance’s oil refinery in India, the world’s largest
item.description: Reliance is central to Washington’s efforts to punish Russian energy buyers and contain oil prices amid the war on Iran.

item.title: Iran denies collapse is close as US claims IRGC running out of money
item.description: Iranian authorities defiant despite financial strain, saying they want to lift US blockade and pressure on their terms.

item.title: France PM promises more curfews as authorities seek to regain control
item.description: Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu says local authorities will coordinate with mayors to decide whether to impose curfews.

item.title: Is Russia stalking satellites which help Ukraine from space?
item.description: Analysts say a Russian craft’s close pass by a commercial radar satellite is a first and a warning to Kyiv’s backers.

item.title: Yemen: Maps show 10 years of changing control
item.description: A decade of war has shifted Yemen’s front lines, but the Houthis still hold Sanaa, and no side controls the country.

item.title: Yemen’s critically ill are trapped as war closes the country’s airports
item.description: A re-ignition of Yemen's war has left the chronically sick who need treatment trapped in the country.

item.title: UK to deploy Typhoon jets to help defend Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks
item.description: Ministry of Defence says warplanes will operate in 'defensive role' and not be used to attack Yemeni group.

item.title: Australian MP Helen Haines remains in critical condition after car attack
item.description: Australian MP Helen Haines lost a leg and remains in critical condition after a car attack outside her office.

item.title: Myanmar’s detained ex-leader Suu Kyi receives package from King Charles III
item.description: Military-backed government says it delivered two books and diplomatic correspondence to Aung San Suu Kyi.

item.title: Masoud Pezeshkian: Peace, Not Surrender
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian on sanctions, regional conflict, US-Israel tensions and his call for Muslim unity.

item.title: France’s growing debt woes: How bond markets set countries’ borrowing costs

item.title: US leaving oil-for-security approach, not Middle East: Envoy Tom Barrack
item.description: Barrack highlights limits of US interventions, admitting past regime changes in the Middle East were often mistakes.

item.title: Zelenskyy to hold talks on Russia-Ukraine war with Witkoff, Europeans
item.description: The prime ministers of Norway and Finland will also attend the discussions in Oslo.

item.title: Trump’s approval ratings plummet: what that means for the US midterms

item.title: Albertans reject referendum on independence from Canada

item.title: South Korea to pull more embassy staff from Ukraine after POW row
item.description: Earlier this month, South Korea recalled its ambassador from Kyiv after Zelenskyy disclosed the prisoner transfer.

item.title: Canadian opera singer replaced after he raised Palestinian flag
item.description: Calgary’s opera house has removed a singer from future performances after he raised a Palestinian flag on stage.

item.title: French protests: Is it game over for Macron’s centrists before elections?

item.title: UEFA demands FIFA release key documents on World Cup sell-off plan
